senses.gloss:
—1 Oneness, unity, harmony; तेषां द्वयोर्द्वयोरैक्यं बिभिदे न कदाचन
 R. 10. 82; U. 6. 33.
—2 Unanimity.
—3 Identity, sameness.
—4 Especially, the identity of the human soul or of the universe with the Deity.
—5 An aggregate, whole.
—6 (In alg.) The product of the length and depth of the portions or little
 excavations differing in depth (Colebrooke).
.━{@Comp.@}: ऐक्यारोपः
